svg.title: Yaesu G-5500 ESP32-S3 TFT: ADC clamps and 500 ohm controller rail load
svg.desc: Original TFT wiring with one R35 500 ohm resistor across the ESP32 3.3 V rail and ground, and one lower BAT85 clamp on each ADC input. D7/D8 anodes connect to ground, cathodes to ADC. Source author: Sergey Rodin.
